map.：5 cm × 5 cm 样内数得横密 150 针、纵密 140 针 → 经密: : counting 150 warp stitches and 140 weft stitches in a 5 cm × 5 cm sample → warp density = 150/5 = 30 threads/cm, weft density = 140/5 = 28 threads/cm (i.e. 300×280 threads per 10cm).
map.：经密 30 根/cm + 纬密 28 根/cm = 58 根/cm，总紧度随纱: : warp density 30 threads/cm + weft density 28 threads/cm = 58 threads/cm; total tightness varies with yarn count and weave structure.

map.用密度镜数 5 cm 内根数再换算到 10 cm，避边缘取中间代表性区域。: Count the threads within 5 cm with a densimeter and convert to 10 cm, sampling a representative central area away from the edges.
